limits: The finalists were picked on the same last 200 sessions they are scored on; the honest pick and the 'before' column are the fairer guide.
Index candles, not futures. Decisions on a candle's close, filled at the next candle's open; stops and targets fill at their level (at the open if a candle opens past it). Real fills slip.
Cost 0.035% of the position per round trip; the doubled-cost numbers show how much of the edge survives worse fills.

The 10% capital stop closes a trade once it has lost 10% of the money behind it: at 1x that is a 10% Nifty move, which does not happen inside a day, so at 1x it never triggers; at 5x it is a 2% move, at 10x a 1% move.
Leverage multiplies losses exactly as it multiplies profits. Exchange margin limits how much is available.
